frozen_before_implementation: 2026-10-17; user accepted R1 dc0ac26 and authorized R2
immutable_parent: contracts/nonideal_v2.json; performance thresholds, original52 and motor/PI preservation unchanged
method: First diagnose the accepted R1 numerical implementation; retain failed traces. Any algorithm change gets an explicit new source version and independent component tests before new physical execution. Select no lucky seed/run and do not relax criteria.

native_false_valid.definition: control_permit AND (abs(wrapped theta_now-true theta_now)>8 electrical degrees OR abs(raw estimated rpm-true rpm)/max(abs(true rpm),1)>0.03)
native_false_valid.scope: entire run including startup and transients; no truth enters any estimator or permission guard

logging.original52: All original logs, classes and SampleTime unchanged; R3 exact same-configuration baseline comparison
logging.observer_control: All current/SMO/PLL/truth/interval logs retained at every JEOS
logging.observer_publication: Record every completed packet at JEOS+3us; never compare publication theta with mismatched truth epoch
logging.observer_native_display: Large voltage36 and held flags sampled at JEOS; native computation unchanged; observer Scopes disabled in headless runs
logging.native_evaluation: Truth-only evaluation inside 观测, every62.5ns. Integer counters for false-valid run/total, permission/timing/ADC/age violations, low-speed permission; record counters at every PWM period including final stop
logging.native_event_trace: Enabled logger records every false-valid/permit/reason/live flag transition, every publication and every PWM heartbeat. Fields include native time, booleans, errors, truth and estimate, age. Offline event durations must equal native counters
logging.short_validation: 20ms normal engineering profile with compact logging: full original52 and common control outputs equal accepted R1 archive; native monitor component oracles and event/counter agreement required before long diagnostics

failure_policy: Preserve every attempt/source/configuration. At most one retry only for explicit native 0xc0000005/0xc000001d. A completed performance failure remains failed; new source versions are clearly distinguished. No third same-version native retry.
single_factor_diagnosis: If combined accuracy fails, use preregistered same-speed controls: matched estimated frontend only, matched estimated deadtime/device only, calibrated gain/bias only. Never fit angle to truth. Changes and configurations are recorded, all parent normal thresholds unchanged.
hard_fault_requirements: First native supervisor call revokes permit. After missing/ADC/timing/reset, rebuild history and lock before repermission; quantify recovery on physical traces. Low 200rpm/stop evaluation windows deny permission; accuracy not claimed. R0 sequence/stale/time-integrity fixtures remain mandatory.
plant_separation: Plant R/L modifications use plant-only symbols/blocks and restore originals. Controller/observer nominal motor and PI values do not receive injected truth. Dynamic sources are restored. No estimator truth import outside evaluation.
candidate_protocol: Completed R2 candidate is frozen before full matrix. R3 independently replays final complete traces and compares all original52; R1 archives/85M-source/90-file fingerprints remain immutable.
gate: Stop after the R2 node record for user review; report any failed/incomplete case as not passed. No feedback takeover or measured hardware claim.
